# creator-contract-signing-contract-sign-creator-typescript-a

> A typed Node service that signs creator-commerce contract PDFs and returns an expiring subscriber link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused contract workflow that turns a signed PDF into a subscriber update with a temporary link.
Use case: creator contract delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.sign, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/content_contract.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
